cross_component_finding: This page is this round's cleanest confirmation that the existing tls: vocabulary - built almost entirely from a single reference page (learn/security/on-the-wire-security.md, this same batch) - survives being read against the full administration procedure: eight of nine reused tls: concepts (cluster-encryption-level, min-tls-version-setting, cipher-suite-preference, cipher-suite-list, hsts, legacy-tls-versions, loopback-interface, node-addition-naming-convention) map cleanly onto this page's CLI/REST worked examples with no forced-fit or contradiction. Only one gap surfaced: disableWWWAuthenticate, documented in the identical style as the already-covered disableUIOverHttp/disableUIOverHttps, but never named on the reference page - a genuine miss rather than a different mechanism. The strict-mode operational checklist (pause Eventing functions, secure XDCR first, node-to-node encryption first) is this page's own distinctive content with no equivalent on the conceptual-overview page: it is the only place in the corpus that ties tls:cluster-encryption-level to eventing:function and server:xdcr as hard operational preconditions, and to eventing:visual-debugger as a documented casualty (the debugger's port stops working once strict mode is live, since it is non-TLS only).
